arrivals: Somebody comes through who's on duty here.
They step out of the inner room and pull the door to behind them.
They arrive from the other side, briefly, on an errand.
departures: They go back through and the door is closed properly.
They're called from inside and answer and go.
They finish what they're doing out here and return to the post.
looks: On duty. Doing the job. Not obstructing you and not standing aside.
They know whether you're expected and it isn't their place to say.
They have the list. The list is turned away from you out of habit.
They're kind about it, which is the part that has no answer.
name: the one on the door
